scripts.ios:dev: react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform ios --dev true --bundle-output ios/main.jsbundle --assets-dest ios && react-native run-ios --simulator='iPhone 16 Pro Max' --configuration Debug
scripts.ios:release: react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform ios --dev false --bundle-output ios/main.jsbundle --assets-dest ios && react-native run-ios --configuration Release
scripts.clean:ios: rm -rf ios/build ios/Pods ios/Podfile.lock node_modules && rm -rf ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/* && npm install
scripts.clean:android: rm -rf android/app/build android/build node_modules && npm install
scripts.clean:final: npm cache clean --force && rm -rf android/app/build android/build ios/build ios/Pods ios/Podfile.lock node_modules && rm -rf ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/* && npm install
scripts.postinstall: cd ios && pod install && cd .. || echo 'Skipping iOS pods install (non-macOS system)'
